title: docattest adapter protocol, version 1: the project as open describes it, its surfaces, snapshots and manifests
description: Every value the protocol carries. Optional fields are omitted, never null, unless a type says null. Paths are relative to the project root, with / separators.

SurfaceEntry.description: A surface as the config wrote it. What it means is the adapter's to say.

SurfaceResolution.description: Where a surface resolved. Printed by the report, and passed on as it is in --json.

entry.description: The file it is read from, relative to the project root when inside it.

display.description: The package and its version as the language writes them ('name@1.2.0', 'name 1.2.0'); the text report prints it.

Snapshots.description: The snapshots of the project: the directory they are read from, and their data by name.

Manifests.description: The manifests fact expressions name in manifest("<path>"): the data of each that could be read, by the path as the expression writes it. Each is an object.
